2609.31403.title: Sorry Robot, Happy Human: Vision-Language Models Read Only One of Two Legible Typographic Layers
2609.31403.paper_summary: Vision-language models (VLMs), despite their success in optical character recognition (OCR) tasks, are vulnerable to typographic attacks and have a fragile structure for images with multiple text layers. In this study, the DecoyBench dataset was created using the Decoy Font method. The dataset consists of 300 images, each containing text with sharp contour lines superimposed on another text with soft shading. Six recent closed-source models from three different model families were evaluated using this dataset under two different prompting conditions (naive and guided) and at two different resolutions ($512\times512$ and $64\times64$). A validation study showed that human participants could read both text layers with high accuracy. In contrast, the models, with most variants and both prompting methods, read the contour text with near-human accuracy at high resolution, but almost never fully extracted the shading text. At low resolution, the contour text could not be read by either the models or humans, while the shading text could be extracted with high accuracy. The findings indicate that the evaluated VLMs exhibit a consistent behavioral limitation when processing typographic structures containing multiple spatial frequency layers.
2609.31403.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLMs）儘管在光學字符識別（OCR）任務中取得了成功，但對排版攻擊十分脆弱，並且對於具有多個文本層的圖像結構脆弱。在本研究中，使用Decoy Font方法創建了DecoyBench數據集。該數據集包含300張圖像，每張圖像都包含具有銳利輪廓線的文本，並疊加在另一個具有柔和陰影的文本上。使用此數據集對來自三個不同模型家族的六個最新封閉源模型進行了評估，並在兩種不同的提示條件（天真和引導）下，以及在兩種不同的解析度（$512\times512$和$64\times64$）下進行。驗證研究顯示，人類參與者能夠以高準確度閱讀兩個文本層。相反，這些模型在大多數變體和兩種提示方法下，在高解析度下以接近人類的準確度閱讀輪廓文本，但幾乎從未完全提取陰影文本。在低解析度下，無論是模型還是人類都無法閱讀輪廓文本，而陰影文本則能夠以高準確度提取。研究結果表明，被評估的VLMs在處理包含多個空間頻率層的排版結構時，顯示出一致的行為限制。
